themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in accessing social benefits, housing, and public services. This theme has intensified with recent coalition agreements in Spain and Italy, reflecting a broader transnational trend.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Secured 'national priority' policies in coalition agreements with PP in Castilla y León, Extremadura, and Aragón, restricting aid and housing access to long-term residents.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government has faced EU pressure but continues to advocate for policies that prioritize Italian nationals in social welfare and housing.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for policies that prioritize Swedish nationals in housing and social benefits, aligning with the broader 'national priority' rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes policies to prioritize Norwegian citizens in public housing and social services, echoing the 'national priority' theme.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella's popularity surged after advocating for policies that prioritize French nationals in social benefits and public services.

themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces growing internal divisions within his party, La Libertad Avanza, as his approval ratings decline. Disputes over judicial appointments and policy directions have intensified, threatening his political agenda and re-election prospects.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties have made significant gains in recent local elections across Europe, particularly in Germany, Italy, and Spain. These victories reflect a broader trend of increasing far-right influence in regional governance.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD secured mayoral positions in regional elections, such as in Zehdenick, and continues to gain traction in local governance.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's party consolidated power in local elections, particularly in regions like Calabria and Liguria, while facing internal challenges.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox made gains in local elections, securing key positions in coalition governments with PP in Castilla y León, Extremadura, and Aragón.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to gain influence in local governance, particularly in municipalities where they advocate for stricter immigration policies.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are experiencing internal divisions, with factions clashing over leadership, policy directions, and strategic alliances. These divisions threaten party cohesion and electoral prospects.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Internal divisions have emerged between Fidesz loyalists and supporters of Péter Magyar's Tisza Party, particularly over EU relations and domestic policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage faces criticism from within his party over his rhetoric and leadership style, particularly in the wake of the Henry Nowak murder case.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Internal tensions between Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella over leadership and policy directions, particularly regarding retirement reforms.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal conflicts between Patricia Bullrich and Karina Milei over judicial appointments and policy directions have intensified.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders across the U.S., Europe, and Latin America have responded to recent Middle East conflicts with a mix of pro-Israel rhetoric, anti-Iran policies, and critiques of perceived weak responses from mainstream governments.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration brokered a ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon, while continuing to advocate for strong pro-Israel policies and anti-Iran measures.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government has taken a strong pro-Israel stance, aligning with U.S. policies on the Middle East and criticizing Iran.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government has supported Israel in the Israel-Lebanon conflict, while advocating for stronger EU measures against Iran.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticized Ukraine's stance on Middle East conflicts, particularly its perceived alignment with anti-Israel policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella and Marine Le Pen have taken a pro-Israel stance, criticizing mainstream French policies as too lenient on Iran and Palestine.
